_comment: Column mapping order-json <-> Base Workflow 'QUẢN LÝ ĐƠN HÀNG SẢN XUẤT' (id 1318). CONFIRMED live: the workflow has only 2 custom fields — so_phieu_ycsx (Số phiếu YCSX = order id, text) and thong_tin_nhap_hang (input-table). There are NO order columns and NO result columns; order data comes from the YCSX .xlsx attached to each job (downloadable via job/form -> files). Write-back to result columns is Phase 2: admin must add the result columns to the workflow, and the token needs edit rights (job/edit currently returns HTTP 500 with this token).
workflow_name: QUẢN LÝ ĐƠN HÀNG SẢN XUẤT
